parts.name: 90 Degree Structural Right Angle Pivot Nub
parts.description: Milled aluminum structural pivot nub that mounts to a 15 series profile with no machining, perpendicular to the mounting profile. Structural pivot arms bolt to it to create a structural pivot ranging from 0-180 degrees; a slot tab helps prevent rotation and assists alignment with the T-slot.
features: No machining required
Perpendicular to mounting profile
Creates structural pivot ranging from 0-180 degrees
Slot tab helps prevent rotation, assists in alignment with T-slot
parts.dimension_notes: A = overall height, B = width, G = depth (bottom view), C = base to pivot hole center, D = back face to pivot hole center, E = pivot hole size (printed as a thread size, 5/16)

remaining_doubts: 3330 is printed as 5/16-18 x 11/16” FBHSCS on 4-136/4-137 (Mount Arm to Nub) but as 5/16-18 x 5/8” FBHSCS on 4-141/4-143 (Included Hardware, Mount Arm to Nub); each part keeps the text of its own page.
Included Hardware (Mount Nub to T-Slot) qty is printed as '1 or 2' for all assembly variants (0 Degree, 90 Degree, Universal); kept verbatim as a string rather than guessing per nub type.
The assemblies use nubs 4387 (0 Degree), 4388 (90 Degree) and 4386 (Universal), which are not the nubs listed on 4-136/4-137 (4402, 4403); those nub part numbers are not detailed in this chunk.
Material specification and hardware tables for the 0/90 Degree assemblies (4-140, 4-142) are printed only on the continuation pages 4-141/4-143 and were applied to all assemblies of the same product.
